issue.title: Poster frame and metadata for video artifacts in the Agents-tab file panel

task_type_fields.proposal:
When a video artifact row is selected in the Agents-tab file panel, show a poster frame and the ffprobe metadata summary (for example `▶ Video 0:07 · 2560×1548 · 30 fps · h264 · 1.2 MB`) inside the TUI. Users could then tell what a clip is before they open the tmux viewer pane. Reuse the persistent, content-digest-keyed frame cache and metadata cache in src/sase/ace/tui/graphics/_viewer_video_frames.py and format_video_metadata_summary in _viewer_video_media.py. Do all ffprobe/ffmpeg work off the Textual UI thread, follow the tui_perf.md rules, and keep those modules off the TUI first-paint import closure (tests/ace/tui/test_app_import_budget.py).

Proposed by phase bead sase-1tb.6 (motion-handoff) note #2 and routed here by the sase-1tb land agent. Background: research:202611/fast_video_artifact_pane/fast_video_artifact_pane.md.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1tb covered only the tmux viewer pane and deferred the in-TUI file-panel poster rider by name in its plan's "Deferred" list.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1tb deferred the in-TUI file-panel poster rider; phase sase-1tb.6 proposed it as a follow-up and the epic lander is routing it to the backlog.
